headword: リチウムイオン{電池|でんち}
reading: りちうむいおんでんち

definitions.explanation: A rechargeable battery that stores energy by moving lithium ions between electrodes. Widely used in smartphones, laptops, and electric vehicles for its high energy density.

examples.english: Lithium-ion batteries can be recharged repeatedly.

notes:
A compound of リチウムイオン (lithium-ion) and ⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧ (battery). The dominant rechargeable battery in modern portable electronics and electric vehicles, valued for its high energy density and long cycle life. Also called リチウムイオン{二次|にじ}⟦{電池|でんち}→電池：01472_denchi⟧.
